chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who divorces his wife while she is pregnant, he said: 'Her waiting period is until she gives birth to her child, and upon him is her maintenance until she gives birth to her child.'

key_terms.تَضَعَ حَمْلَهَا: She gives birth to her child

ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a divorced pregnant woman in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from the Tahdhib al-Ahkam clarifies that a pregnant woman's 'iddah concludes with childbirth rather than a fixed lunar month, a ruling derived directly from Quran 65:4. It further establishes the husband's ongoing financial obligation (nafaqah) during this period, reflecting the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the continuity of support until the physical state of pregnancy ends.
